name: eko
description: Codex-native campaign analytics, drafting, review, monitoring, and universal-canvas Prosecco microsite creation for Eko.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze campaigns, draft mailings, and build branded campaign microsites.
interface.longDescription: Eko is a Codex plugin for privacy-safe campaign performance and fundraising analysis, historical mailing memory, campaign strategy, evidence-aware email drafting, progressive language review, campaign monitoring, and Prosecco-native microsites whose versioned creative canvas reuses protected petition, sharing, Braintree, 3-D Secure, and PayPal components.
capabilities: Native petition, sharing, and Braintree donation journeys
defaultPrompt: Draft a campaign email from this brief.
Strategize this campaign using past mailing memory.
Review this mailing draft before launch.
Prepare this Prosecco campaign page as a branded petition microsite with sharing and donations.
Create a daily monitor for this campaign draft.
